_comment: Source of truth for commentator text. Hand-editable. Regenerate with `python3 tools/commentary_gen.py --lines` (Gemini), voice with `--voice` (ElevenLabs). These seed lines ship so the commentator works with no API key at all -- it just shows captions instead of speaking.
_voice_direction: An excitable but warm sports commentator calling a dog's mountain climb. Short, punchy, affectionate. Never mean about the dog.

start: Paws on the rock. Here we go.
Thirty ledges. One very good dog.
Let's see what this dog has.
escape: Ooh, felt the heat on that one!
That was all whisker, no burn.
Dodged it by a tail hair.
The vent blew and the dog was already gone.
hit: Caught by the cloud. Shake it off.
streak: Six clean. This dog is flying.
Not a scorch mark in sight.
Reading the clouds like a book.
half: Halfway. The air gets thin here.
near: Summit in sight. Don't rush it.
So close. This is where it hurts.
summit: Top of the mountain! What a climb!
That dog just conquered the sky.
struggle: Legs are heavy. Take your time.
This mountain is not being kind.
